title: Dragon Ball Super Reboot Raises Major Release Schedule Questions With New Update
content: Dragon Ball Super is ready for its return later this year with a brand new reboot anime series taking on the Battle of Gods arc , and a new schedule update has sparked some major questions about its release schedule.

title: 30 Years Later, Legendary Sci-Fi Anime Is Getting New Streaming Launch With Classic English Dub
content: A legendary science fiction anime is going to get a new streaming home soon, and it’s finally going to be launching with its missing English dub after all this time. Neon Genesis Evangelion is arguably one of the most influential science-fiction anime of all time.

title: One of The Greatest Comedy Anime of All Time Is Losing a Major Platform in August
content: As the anime industry continues to grow in popularity across the globe, major streaming platforms are also contributing to making popular shows easily accessible for fans. Crunchyroll is still the largest streaming hub for anime across various regions.

title: Kaguya Sama: Love Is War Creator’s Dark Fantasy Gets Cancelled After Hitaus
content: Following the controversial ending of Oshi no Ko , author Aka Akasaka returned with yet another bold and unique series titled Märchen Crown . The manga began serializing in Shueisha’s Weekly Young Jump magazine in March last year.

title: Crunchyroll’s Darkest Anime of 2026 Kicks Off New Arc With Trailer – Watch Now
content: One new Summer 2026 anime has been taking over Crunchyroll since it made its debut last month, and is gearing up for a whole new arc with a new trailer introducing an important new member to the voice cast.

title: 5 Incredibly Long-Running Anime Worth Your Time
content: The world of anime is expansive, with countless series waiting to be explored . Whether it’s action or mystery, there’s something suitable for every fan. While the industry has now popularized short, seasonal series, anime has no shortage of incredible long-running series that often span across hundreds of episodes.

title: Yamame Yasashiki Gets Heroine Visual for The 100 Girlfriends Who Really Love You Anime
content: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really Love You Season 2 anime revealed a heroine visual for Yamame Yasashiki, Rentaro’s 14th girlfriend. Studio Bibury Animation Studios is again in charge of the animation, with Hikaru Sato back to direct. You can see the new visual below.

content: Black Clover has finally answered a major question about Asta’s missing father, and it’s a wild explanation as for why he’s never been seen in the series. title: New 'Digimon' Anime Announced for 2027
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account of the Digimon anime franchise announced an anime project on August 1. The new series is scheduled to air in 2027. The Digimon franchise began in 1997 as a virtual pet game and later gained popularity with the 1999 anime Digimon Adventure ( Digimon: Digital Monsters ).
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Hotaru no Yomeiri' Unveils Additional Cast, Ending Theme, Second Teaser Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Oreco Tachibana 's Hotaru no Yomeiri ( Firefly Wedding ) manga unveiled additional cast, ending theme, and teaser promotional video on Sunday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 9 at 11.30 p.m. on Fuji TV noitaminA.
